root_cause: ScatterElementsUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices (scatter_elements_update.cpp) and GatherND8LayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices (gather_nd.cpp) are negative tests supplying out-of-range indices expecting the CPU plugin to raise ov::Exception during inference. All 7 parameterizations (ScatterElementsUpdate i32/i64 index x f32/i32 data, and GatherND8 i8/f32/bf16 data x i32 index) failed because no exception was thrown, meaning the CPU kernels for ScatterElementsUpdate and GatherND still accept out-of-range indices silently instead of validating and rejecting them. This is an exact repeat of signature c679b29f4fb1c2b4, previously recorded 2026-11-20T11:47:11Z on an unrelated GPU-plugin-only commit (#40041). The current triggering commit (#39332, 'hsm: Implement codec for compile options') only touches HSM compile-options codec headers/Template plugin, also entirely unrelated to the CPU plugin's ScatterElementsUpdate/GatherND kernels (src/plugins/intel_cpu/src/nodes/). Combined with the sibling pattern c7d3b823733ac934 (ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest, 4 prior occurrences), this confirms a persistent, commit-independent gap in CPU plugin index bounds-checking for indexed-update/gather ops rather than a regression introduced by any specific push.
reproduction_steps: Build the CPU plugin functional test binary and run: ./bin/intel64/Release/ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter='*smoke_ScatterElementsUpdateOutOfRangeIndices/ScatterElementsUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices*:*smoke_GatherND8OutOfRangeIndices/GatherND8LayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices*'. Confirm no ov::Exception is thrown for the out-of-range index value 1000 on axis 0 (ScatterElementsUpdate) or index (1,0) against a (4,4) tensor (GatherND8).
recommended_actions: Add bounds-checking to the ScatterElementsUpdate CPU kernel (src/plugins/intel_cpu/src/nodes/scatter_update.cpp) so out-of-range indices throw ov::Exception during execution.
Add bounds-checking to the GatherND CPU kernel (src/plugins/intel_cpu/src/nodes/gather_nd.cpp) so out-of-range indices throw ov::Exception during execution.
Treat this as a confirmed recurring systemic issue (2nd occurrence of c679b29f4fb1c2b4 in under 9 hours) and escalate to CPU plugin owners rather than re-triaging per push.
Cross-reference with pattern c7d3b823733ac934 (ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest, 4 occurrences) for a single shared index-validation fix across the scatter/gather CPU kernel family.
prevention_strategies: Fix the missing bounds validation once in a shared index-check helper used by all scatter/gather CPU kernels, then keep these tests permanently enabled as regression guards. Since this signature has now recurred twice in under a day against unrelated commits, consider temporarily marking the 7 affected parameterizations as known-failing (with a tracking ticket) to avoid repeatedly red-flagging unrelated PRs in the merge queue and post-commit pipeline until the kernel fix lands.
historical_context: Exact repeat of signature c679b29f4fb1c2b4, first recorded 2026-11-20T11:47:11Z (run 44713158000, unrelated GPU commit #40041). This is the 2nd occurrence, confirming the issue is persistent and commit-independent. Also closely related to signature c7d3b823733ac934 (ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices), which has recurred 4 times since 2026-11-13, always for the same underlying reason (missing CPU-side index bounds validation) and always unrelated to the triggering commit.
